Avery C: Quick sync 1: Meridian QBR prep. Need owners for slides, top renewal risks (3), and one clear exec ask per lane. Who's in?
Priya S: I'll take onboarding health. Will pull activation funnels and time-to-value.
Jonah M: I'll do renewal risks & mitigation. Noted: stalled integrations + support backlog + license compression.
Lena R: I can own enablement + outcomes slide. Want to highlight new walkthrough vids + pilot results.
Avery C: Cool. Please post a 1-line slide summary and a single exec ask by EOD Wed.
Priya S: Slide summary: Checklist + guided tours raised activation by 12%, but 18% churn during weeks 2-3. Ask: $10k for targeted onboarding outreach (partner).
Jonah M: Slide summary: Risks = (1) stalled integrations (2) mid-trial usage dip (3) licensing compression. Ask: Product to allocate a 2-week integration fast-path and exec sponsor.
Lena R: Summary: Enablement pilots cut time-to-first-success by 22% and NPS up 6pts. Ask: Approve recurring weekly office hours + content refresh budget $3k.
Avery C: Ops-bot, attach latest health snapshot to thread and include "Net renewal risk (30d)" metric widget.
ops-bot: Attaching dashboard snapshot: https://dash.redwood.example/customer/meridian/health?snapshot=2026-03-15 :paperclip:
Priya S: Putting numbers in a shared doc -> https://docs.redwood.example/meridian-qbr/data. I'll add slide notes (30s bullets).
Jonah M: I'll draft a 2-week mitigation runbook for stalled integrations and a triage heatmap. Plan to include owners + timelines.
Lena R: I have a small onboarding flow GIF for the slide. Can someone confirm size constraints so it doesn't break PDF export?
Avery C: Keep GIF <2MB and loop to show before/after. If design help needed ping @design-ops.
Priya S: Who will voice each ask during exec readout? I nominate Avery for onboarding ask, Jonah for integration/risk ask, Lena for enablement ask.
Avery C: Happy to present onboarding. Jonah you OK to cover risks and the mitigation ask?
Jonah M: Yep, will present the risk slide + runbook.
Avery C: Timeline: freeze slides Thu 10am. Owners: post final slides + 30-45s speaker notes under each slide by Wed end.
Priya S: Will post slide + notes by Wed 6pm.
Lena R: Slide + GIF + notes by Wed 9pm.
Jonah M: Risk slide + runbook by Thu 8am for review.
Avery C: I'll stitch and share a review link by Thu 9am. If any blockers surface, flag here immediately. :thumbsup:
